about_the_game:
💥 Isekai: FPS with a Unique Hero Ability – “Online Shopping” 💥

"I died while playing an FPS. I woke up in heaven. I got unique abilities and access to an online store."

You know that feeling when you’re chilling at your PC, playing a shooter... and suddenly a goddess’s sneeze teleports you to a magical world full of cute bears that immediately start attacking you? No? Well, it’s time to find out.

In Isekai: I’m an FPS Hero – Demo, you play as an ordinary gamer who gets summoned to another world due to a mistake made by the goddess of gambling.

Right off the bat, you’re handed a pistol, a few blessings, and a tutorial on online shopping.

Your mission? Save this kawaii land from a demonic invasion… using a rifle bought from an online store.

🔫 FPS Gameplay with an RPG Twist:

Shoot, collect cores, upgrade weapons, and level up your rank.

Receive blessings and abilities from goddesses, like “Light as a Feather” or “Death is Not the End.”

Boost your stats, upgrade your gear, and battle the first bosses. Return to heaven to heal.

👼 The Goddesses Await:

Riskia – the scatterbrained goddess of shopping who summoned you by accident.

Kana – a craftswoman with a heart of steel and hands of gold.

Mei – the goddess of life and death. You’ll meet her… when you die.

Riza – the bored goddess of war who didn't want your help.

🐻 Take on Divine Quests:

The inhabitants of Arcadia have been corrupted by dark forces. Now, they roam as raging hordes, driven by an uncontrollable thirst for destruction.

Help the goddesses reclaim their lost souls, so that one day they may bring them back to life — in a calmer, better world.

👿 Face the Weakest Forces of the Demon Lord:
When you encounter the first warriors serving the forces of evil… don’t hesitate.
Remember, someone is commanding them — and that someone is bound to be a powerful foe.

💬 Dialogue System with Humor

The goddesses won’t hold back their comments — sometimes they’ll support you, sometimes they’ll troll you.
Just remember: their favor has to be earned.

🛒 Wishlist = A New World

This is just a demo.

But if you want to discover the rest of the world, unlock more weapons, more ways to grow, deepen your relationships with the goddesses — and meet new ones — add the game to your wishlist.

Heaven is waiting for you, and Arcadia needs a hero...

short_description: I'm a die-hard FPS gamer. By mistake, I became the hero of an Isekai story. An incompetent Goddess summoned me to her world to defeat the Demon Lord. I'm in my element—guns, upgrades, action, and hordes of monsters to slay. There's even some magic… and Goddesses…
